integrity: Proof gives all-n optimality by symmetry averaging, stabilizer-fixed cycle obstruction, and exact Laplacian potential; standalone finite rational checks are supplementary. No independent validation.
limitations: Unweighted triangular graphs J(n,2), integers n>=5, real coordinate-l1 ambient edge norm only. No uniqueness asserted outside the invariant class or for arbitrary Johnson J(n,k). Priority may be incomplete.
title: Sharp two-sided projection constants for triangular graph edge spaces
